name: m4t1
description: Delegated management week (SPEC §2.7 / issue #56): a five-Pop village runs one foreman-appointed kitchen, one food-domain manager obeying player strategy sliders, and a mid-run DIRECT produce override that crosses domains onto an unmanaged sawpit. The delegation layer speaks the shared inbox (delegated produce commands fill and rotate; OrderLock rows fence off directly-ordered Pops); management skill XP accrues per serving pass. Fixture pins milestone digests every 150th tick plus a legible staffing/lock/xp trace, the §2.7 acceptance beats (saturation under a foreman, slider consolidation within the hour, override sticking against continued delegation pressure), and doubles as the extended double-run determinism canary.
